text: He had a saying, also, that the Roman people were like sheep; for they, when single, do not obey, but when altogether in a flock, they follow their leaders: "So you," said he, "when you have got together in a body, let yourselves be guided by those whom singly you would never think of being advised by."
author: Plutarch
speaker: Cato the Elder
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
